diagnosis_evidence.underconvergence_rule: YES if any true history model has Macro Train Corr at least 0.10 below same-fold State-only AND step100-to200 normalized MSE drops by at least 0.01 absolute and 5% relative

decision_thresholds.stable_gain: mean and median paired Corr delta > 0 and at least 4/6 folds improve
decision_thresholds.train_not_collapsed: model Macro Train Corr mean >= State-only mean - 0.10 and >= 0.5
decision_thresholds.repeat_control_gain: mean and median true-history minus repeat-current delta > 0 and at least 4/6 folds improve

diagnosis_evidence.interpretation_boundary: History-model improvement is predictive evidence for held-out realized RTG only; it does not prove a POMDP or establish that the formal 400D representation is mathematically insufficient.
